description: Justin Fleming for PA State Representative in the 105th state legislative district. Public servant in Susquehanna Township since 2004 and resident from youth, Justin attended South Side Elementary for kindergarten, grew up in the Edgemont neighborhood, and followed in his father's footsteps as a proud Susquehanna Township High School graduate. As state representative, he will work hard for all of the citizens of the 105th district.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Friends of Justin Fleming
title: Elect Justin Fleming for PA State Representative | 105th District
